name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Rocky Mountain Saunas is a highly regarded infrared sauna company based in Arvada, Colorado. Owner Mike Henson has 10 years industry knowledge in the infrared sauna business. He originally worked as a Marketing Director for a large, national infrared sauna company. After installing an infrared sauna in his home and using it regularly, he became passionate about the health benefits of infrared saunas and wanted to help others experience the same positive effects he had over a short period of time.



After a few months of regular use Mike first noticed his energy levels increase and his extra weight (or ‘spare tyre’ as he called it) disappear. He also felt an immediate sense of ‘mellowness’ and his ‘crows feet’ began to shrink. Mike had never felt so well. When he read other people’s testimonies about pain relief and general detoxification he realised infrared saunas had much to offer the general population.



The personal approach by Rocky Mountain Saunas is highly regarded by its many customers and at Infrared Sauna Parts we are delighted to stock spare parts and repair advice for these saunas. Please contact us for more information.
